description: Webhook-trigger secret lifecycle. 'rotate' = planned hygiene: mints a new secret (returned ONCE, with the hook URL beside it so the sender can be reconfigured in one step) while the previous secret keeps verifying for a 24h grace. 'complete_rotation' = the sender has moved; end the grace now so the old secret stops verifying immediately. 'revoke' = compromise: the hook rejects every request from now on and any open grace dies with it — irreversible, create a new webhook trigger to hand the sender a fresh URL + secret. Only valid on kind 'webhook'.

action.description: 'rotate' (new secret, old one verifies for 24h) | 'complete_rotation' (end that grace now) | 'revoke' (kill the hook).

name: sapiom_dev_agents_schedule_secret
